<script type="text/javascript">
        $(document).ready(function () {
            if ($('.slideshow').children().length == 1) {
                $('#prev,#next').hide();
            }
            else {
                $('.slideshow').cycle({
                    fx: 'scrollHorz',
                    timeout: 8000,
                    speed: 500,
                    pause: 1,
                    next: '#next',
                    prev: '#prev',
                    after: function () {
                        if (!this.dataset.statlogged) {
                            // Log case study slide impression
                            logSlideStat(this.dataset.name, this.dataset.brand);
                            this.dataset.statlogged = 1;
                        }
                    }
                });
            }
        });

        function logSlideStat(name, brand) {
            dataLayer.push({
                'event': 'ResultsDisplayed',
                'ecommerce': {
                    'impressions': [
                    {
                        'name': name,
                        'brand': brand,
                        'dimension1': 'Case Study',
                        'list': 'Homepage',
                        'category': 'Selfserve'
                    }]
                }
            });
        }
    </script>
